tei:div.tei:p: ja nang rje btsun thams cad makyen pa tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag shāms sa/sdu shārnyi/ma/ rā pas khyim bci 077 5650btam sa mas smo 8167 ma 'i 577065 75dzo

༄༅/ /jo nang rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag bsdoyinas thedu/ /bod/ 43 1 stod/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thasnarnam thar ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod/pod/ 44 3 smad/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tham rnam thar ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod/sasang ba'i rnam thar sosas rnam thar 'asa' chis bzhugs/ 940sangs rgyas rjes drar dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag zung du lajug pa ba/nugs/ tsa tsho tsi twa ra na tha'i nawa/ gdam sa mgur 'bum gye skor/ 297

rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i zhal gdams mgur 'bum gyi skor bzhugs/ 1dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel ba zab mo'i don mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma/ 128dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi byung khungs nyer mkho/ 325pod/ 46 4zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zhes bya ba tso 1dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 3dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa dpag bsam ljon shing la 'i〈cog pa/ 6dpe ro dus kyi sebor lo'idakyil macoragyi cho ga yeshes rgya mtsho dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 100dpar dus kye 3bor lo'i bstod pa'am mngon chogs snye bar bsdus pa/ 196—2

bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi bskang gso bde stong rol pa zhes bya ba bzhusanas/ 206dus 'khor tshogs mchod bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ 217dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dgyesaglu bde chen rdo rje'i gsang tshig zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 224dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga nang gi mun sel gyi lag len/ 228dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chog las rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho la 'jug pa bzhugs/ 239dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gong ma'i cho ga 255dpa pa dus kyi snyegabor lo snying po'i dkyil sabor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 285ngapal sdom pa chen po'i sgrub dkyil gyi rem pa'i khyad par gsal byed / 328—)

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa ོ po'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa bzhugs/ 387dus 'khor sdom chen gyi thig tshon gsal byed/ 395dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dang 'grel pa'i phyag rgya'i rnam grangs rab gsal snang ba bzhus/sa/ —400pod/ 47 5dus 'khor lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa/ 1dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchod 'a nyer mkho/ 21dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i lho sgo'i cho ga 65thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ 72smon lam gal po che/ 78rir sasnyis smor lam/ 8()dpa pa dus kyi /seboralori dkyi ri ge'od byi cho sa'i snar bsang bdung rtsi'i rgya mtsho bzhugs/ 85 /—

pod/ 48 6dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa rnam par bshad pa dngos grub nyer 'tsho/ 1pod/ 49 7zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan/ 1rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid yig mthong ba don ldan gyi lhan thabs 'od brgya 'bar ba bzhugs/ 111sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag snying po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sdoms / 389zab lam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi lus sbyong 'brul 'khor gyi man ngag gsal byed bzhugs/ 394pong/ 5() 8zab lam jo rje'i rlal 'byor gye rngam/ nga/ra bshang pa rgyas par bstan pa zung snyelajug rab tā gsal ba chen po/ 1do

rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i snying po stan thog gcig ma'i khrid yig bsdos/sa/ 252rdo rje'i rnal lor gyi phyi'i ngo sprod/ 262sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i ngo sprod nang ma/ 282rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i rtags tshad kyi yi ge/ 324spyor drug gegs sel bzhugs/ ca 356sbyor drug gi dri lan bzhugs/ 395bod/ 54 6dpa smu gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal/ 1gsang 'dus sgrub dkyil 'bar ba'i 'od gsal/ 5)4ra nga sī sas pa ba 83dus pa 'jam ru 'i rdo rje'i mngon par chogs pa ye shes snang byed ces byab shugs/ ne tsho 75dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil /2bor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ 10 5

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 154gsang 'dus 'phags skor las rim lnga 'gos lugs kyi khrid yig rgyud don gsal ba bzhugs/ 156gsang 'dus 'phags lugs rim lnga smar khrid gdan rdzogs kyi khrid yig 'khrul ba'i dri bral zhes bya ba mar pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba/ 194gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi man ngag las/zab gsal dbyer med kyi khrid yig bzhugs/ 223dpal grol ba'i thig le'i khrid yig mi shigs pa'i rin po che sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 236rem lnga bsdus gsal gyi ṭī ka bzhugs/ 261pong/ 52 10zir/ lnga'e 'grel za jo rje 'chang 7 hu dgongs pa/ 1

pod/ 53 11rgyud rgyal gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'byung rgyas pa yid ches ngo mtshar 1bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i brgyud 'debs dang bkra phunas zhes bya ba bsdo/kas/ 139sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhugs/ 145dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs snying po bzhugs/ 147dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ro langs brgyad skor gyi cho ga 161dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad lha bcu gsum ma'i cho ga 'don pa bsgyur lugs yang dag pa/ 208bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed nag po lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs rdo rje 'ong zer zhes bya ri bzhugs/ 221nga — — nge na gshin rje cas no ri dkyi li krujorgyu gyi cho sa/ bde chen 'od ripar zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 24(32

gshin rje gshed nag po'i khrid yig zhang lugs/ 297'jam dpal gzhin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 302bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug bzhugs/ 318gshed dmar rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi khrid yig mchog tu gsang ba/ 356spros med kyi khrid yig ngo mtshar can bzhugs/ 369pod/ 54 12bcom ldan 'das gzhin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 1'jam dpal gsang lngan gyi dkyil chog bzhugs/ 181ngang 61 jo rje 'jisasabyengakyi rnga pa 'byor ngang 'gre la pa/drug cu rtsa ba'i'i gterachegagingag redonab yis/ 410gtor chog khams gsum zil gnon gyi lhan thabs lde'u thung gzhan la med ga

pa'i khyad chos bzhugs/ 279bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i chos skor la med mi rung gi gal po che bzhugs/ 305bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 346rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi bsreg blugs bsdus pa/ 378bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i tshogs mchod/ 388uṣ+ṭi ṣa rwa lugs kyi ngag 'don rgyun khyer bzhugs/ 392pod/ 55 13bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga skal ba bzang po'i 'jug ngogs/ 1dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i brgyud 'debs/ 30'khor lo stom pa nag po 'bas snyeXsas kyi sgrub thabs bangeb rer = 'i2ri mangs /zhes bya ba ba cirdunas/ 8(dpa pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil chog nag po lugs kyi gsal byed bde ba /(/

chen po'i char yangs bzhugs/ 77'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs lū yi pa'i lugs bde chen 'jug ngogs bzhugs/ — 159dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 200dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bde chen snying po/ — — 257bde mchog lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bde chen snying po/ 280dpal mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs/ 300dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 338pod/ 56 14dpar 2boraro sdom rī/'i dgyer sebor rang ༅ma sa kye sgru nga thabs dgros grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /'khor lo sdom pa khro bo rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba rdo rje he ru ga'i —

sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 213dpal mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog sgrub thabs dga' bde rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bsdos/sa/ 245mnyam sbyor dkyil chog bzhugs/ 281'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho/ 323'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs mchod dge rgya mtsho / 332dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lag mchod bzhugs/ 335dpal khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub snye ma/ 338mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor rgyas pa bzhugs/ 351dang la 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga'i yan lag 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen mo/ 359bde mchog༄ji shā ngag 'don cer bde/ 3—5bange ra/chos khro bo zes tshis 38 sgro

pod/ 57 15bde mchog nag po'i zhabs lugs kyi sgrub thabs rnam ngayand bzhugs/ 1dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa 329pod/ 58 16dpal rim pa bzhi pa'i gzhusang gi 'grel chen gsang ba rab gsal/ 1'phags pa dpyid kyi thig le'i gzhud rnam par bshad pa 'grel pa nges gsang rgya mtsho'i snying po/ 91grub pa'i slob dpon wo po nag po spyod pa pa'i dgongs don rim ba'i snyelam slongs snying por dril ba/ 276dpal bde mchog rim lnga'i khrid yig bzhugs/ 304bde mchog thi rjo gas ri rma rla si sor chen ngo 'i khrid yig ri 18ngo da daX) 17 stod bde mchog bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas bzhugs/ 1d+ku

bde mchog bstod chen gyi rang 'grel phan bde'i rgya mtsho/ 31pod/ 60 1/ smad/bde mchog bstod chen gyi rang 'grel phan bde'i rgya mtsho/ 1pod/ 64 19grub chen dzā lan+ta ra'i do ha'i 'grel pa gsang ba'i mdzod/ 1grub chen nag po spyod pa'i do ha'i 'grel pa zab don lde mig 106/sna pa'i do ha thor bu rnams kyi 'grel pa ngo mtshar 'bar ba 166gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba'i 'grel pa dgongs pa rab gas05 bsdokyigs/ 220pod/ 62 20de nyid bdun pa'i rnam par bshad pa ren chen snye ma bzhugs/ 1tshigs bcang bcu pa' 'grel pa zin bres su/ rtso 68rngo rje theg pa'i gnas lugs gsal byeng/ /ci/ dalas dang po pa rnams snyel phan pa'i rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i 4

nor rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 126zab mo sngags kyi dri lan sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig 156rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa nam mkha'i rdo rje rab tu gsal ba/ 177zab lam bka' rgya ma bzhu/kas/ 184thugs rje chen po tshom bu lugs kyi dmar khrid kyi brgyud 'debs/ 202smar khrid tshom bu lugs bzhugs/ 204snying po don gsum gyi khrid bzhugs/ 211bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i man ngag gi gzhud rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 217 lha so so'i bsnyen pa spyi khyab tu byed tshul bsdus pa/ 230dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i mdzad pa'i bsnyen pa byed chul/ 232gtso ridus brgyung pa 'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs/ 236rgyud snge ྅ ḍi sasdu 'dus kye ra/ngor rtogs/ 238 rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i mngon rtogs tshegs bcad ma/ 244115

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshes bcu'i cho ga 248phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi khrid ces bya ba/ 253badz+ra bhe ra ba'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa/ 260drag po'i thab bskyed gsang ba spyi'i cho ga nas logs su bkod pa legs par/ 262dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs bzhusanas/ 268dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i thig le 290rdo rje gdan bzhi'i 'khrid yig ye shes sgo'abyed/ (323pod/ 63 21dgyes pa rngo rje'i pag :len gsal b.rabyedapa ngapa rmi 'e ru rangagyesapa ches bya ba9kyigs/ 1dpal kyi rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gong ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brang / 5816

dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bi rū pa'i man ngag gong ma'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba bzhugs/ 83dgyes rdor mar lugs kyi khrid yig 'khrul med nges gsang / 138dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i man ngag sbas pa mig 'byed sogs/ 199kyai rdo rje'i rdzogs rim sgron ma gcig pa'i khrid yig ye4sgosarab gsal/ 216dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rdzogs rim de nyid bzhi ldan gyi khrid yig 222phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i byin rlabs bzhugs/ 236dgyes rdor gyi rdzogs rim lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i /'grel pa/ 241phyag rgya bzhi pa'i snying po'i man ngag rab gsal nges don snying po/ 280phyag rgya bzhi pa'i snying po'i ṭaṃ ka bzhugs/ 288kro nga/ 64 22dpal ma hā mā ya'i dgyel 'khor gye sgrub thabs ren chen myu gu 1— ——

dpal mahā mā ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen sgron me/ 12dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i khrid yig rgyal ba'i lam bzang bzhugs/ 44dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul chen mo mahā mā ya'i rgya cher bshad pa de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 57dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba bsdoskyugs/ 208sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid gsal ba/ 225rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas thod pa'i rdzogs rim/ 253pod/ 65 23rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga ngag 'don/ 1rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sreg blugs kyi lag len/ 39pa sa rmo 'i sbyin sres shin tu bsdus rdzu bzhugs /cerdo rje pha ga me'e sgrub thabs chung ba bzhugs/ —rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag bde chen rol pa/ 62 /8

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen thabs bzhugs/ 89nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa/ 92rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba rdo rje phag 31'i sgrub thabs bzhus/sa/ 100rje btsun rngen pa'i gdams ngag gi dmar khrid/ 120rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bden gnyis zhal can sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga bzhugs/ 128smon lam dang bkra shis bzhugs/ 176rje btsun rdo rje phag mo don grub ma'i sgrub mchod kyi yi ge 180sku gsumardo rje phag mo zhes bya ba dbu bcad mar grags pa 'i sgrub mchod ngag 'don bzhugs/ 186 no rje 3 sa mo ngas pa lugs kyi khrid yig dngos grub kyi 'dong 'jo zhesabyangab/nugs/ 94phrin las thams 0 da 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa/ 2183

'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ 239sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me/ 272sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'bar ba bzhugs/ 285bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug ga9༷na la phan pa zhes bya ba bsdokyigs/ 309rje btsun sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 345sgrol ma rla la 'byor ma'i khring yis bange cher myur gter bzhugs/ 37 (sna/pod/ 66 24sgro ruma'irgyudakyi car+sāng/bungs sasal bde byed pa'i pa rgyusagaser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 39—20

rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub rol mtsho 63rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs 67dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga donagasal rgyas byed/ 104ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtogs bzhugs/ 176ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang chog 186zab lam ni gu chos drug gi khrid yig zab don thang mar brdal ba/ 213ni gu'i khrid yig bsdus pa bzhugs/ 315zab lam ni gu chos drug gi gzhung khrid ma mo'i lhan thabs kha skong / tso 327ni gu 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel bzhugs/ 358pod/ 67 25ngang 4 0sa kro dh+ra bo cher po sne/ sayo bla re/nga kyi sgrubathabasabadung pas rngar rgyal bzhugs/ 1dpal gtso po khro bo za po'i dkyil 'khor gyi —21

cho ga rdo rje rol ba/ 16dpal 'khor lo chen po'i sgrub thabs srid gsum 'dul byed/ 44dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil chog srid gsum 'dul byed bzhugs/ 67dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud 'joms rol ba bzhugs/ 116slob ma la dbang bskur bar byed pa'i tshul bzhugs/ 176dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol ba'i las byang dregs pa kun 956la bzhus/sa/ 191thams cadarig pa'i brgyud yig gso sa 'debs su sbyar ba/ 2/()dpal thams cad rig pa'i cho ga 'khor ba kun grol bzhugs/ 215thams cad rag pa'i cho ga ri/bor ba kun grol gyasazur redebs/ ‘ —krong/ 68 26sbyong rgyud kyi snying po'i dor nyi ma'i stobs 'bar bzhugs/ 122

dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bya ba'i rgyud mtha' dag la 0〈cog pa bzhugs/ 54gzungs grwa lnga'i dkyil chog bar chad kun sel bzhugs/ 155gzungs grwa lnga'i cho ga la brten nas byad 'grol byed tshul/ 193tshe chog bdud rtsi'i chu gter gyi brgyud 'debs/ 204tshe chog bdud rtsi'i chu gter bzhugs/ 206tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig gi cho ga bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ 246bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal/ 259bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'jug bde rnams gsal bzhugs/ 290bcom ldan 'das mi 'byugs pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho go capas sgribakun 3joms ba(zhugs/ tsho 311gtor chagasum gyi ri ga re na bzhusas 32 2mngon par dag ri ba'i zhing smon lam mdo sde'i —23

dgongs don bzhugs/ 331pod/ 69 27rnam rgyal dgu'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa 1rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa 20dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdul tshon klu la gtod pa'i lag len/ 32rab gnas kyi cho ga 'gro phan rgyas byed/ 36rab gnas 'gro phan rgyas byed kyi lha thabs ches rgyas pa/ 73swā ts+tsha dang khang bu brtsegs pa sogs la rab gnas mdor bsdus/ 102'chi med 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 105rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rnam par 'byeng pa gsang ba'i 〈snal ma bzhugs/ 109blamedadang byargyudakyi sngagasaspyi'ithunamongadangathunamongam yin pa'i zab gnad yod/ 1 1)sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i chog sgrig legs par bkod pa ngag 24

'don rab gsal bzhugs/ 149sgrol dkar jo bo lugs kyi mngon rtogs tshe sgrub dang bcas pa/ 185gsang ba spyi'i cho ga zhi ba las thams cad pa'i spyin sreg gi cho ga 'bring po bzhugs/ 187bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mchod pa'i gter bzhugs/ 194bla ma mchod pa bde legs rab rgyas bzhugs/ 209sku skyes bcu bzhi'i bkra shis bzhugs/ 220bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bzhugs/ 222bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs/ 225gdon 'grol gyi rlo sa shin tu bsdus rnga bzhugs / rna 229klu gtor ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga bzhugs/ 241gtor ma brgyartsa'i ngag 'don bzhugs/ 2—19bsung gye lag len bzhugs/ 257/chu gtor 'jam dpal ma bzhugs/ 255—25
